responsibility: Provides the x86 MOVRS intrinsic header for scalar and vector loads that use MOVRS semantics. It exposes the scalar `_movrs_i8/_i16/_i32/_i64` helpers and prefetch hint `_m_prefetchrs`, then, on x86_64 with AVX10.2 feature combinations, adds masked and unmasked 128-bit, 256-bit, and 512-bit `_loadrs_` vector APIs for byte, halfword, word, and doubleword elements, making this the main non-AMX MOVRS user-facing intrinsic layer.
